My research publications span information security, cryptography,
digital signatures, digital identity, electronic documents,
finite-field arithmetic, post-quantum cryptography, and artificial
intelligence applied to security.

This bibliography is being progressively consolidated from DBLP,
ORCID, Lattes, Google Scholar, and my personal academic archive.

## Research Areas

Publications can broadly be associated with the following research
directions:

- Cryptography and cryptographic protocols
- Finite-field arithmetic
- Digital signatures
- Public key infrastructure
- Digital identity
- Electronic documents and preservation
- Post-quantum cryptography
- Artificial intelligence and security

As the archive evolves, publications will also be browsable by research
area, year, publication type, and associated project.
